title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: breakout room support
summary: The rollout dates, default availability, licensing baseline and PowerShell call are supported. The governance prose unnecessarily treats the meeting policy's coverage as unknown: Microsoft documents AllowBreakoutRooms as enabling or disabling breakout-room functionality, which includes the breakout sessions this feature joins.

claims.claim: Whether the general AllowBreakoutRooms policy governs the breakout-room participation introduced here is undocumented.

claims.fix: Remove the applicability-unknown caveat from the prose and the first Open questions bullet. Replace the control note with 'Default is True. Replace the two governance sentences beginning 'Learn's description of it covers' with 'Learn describes AllowBreakoutRooms as enabling or disabling Breakout Rooms functionality.' The reference states the general rule without excluding Android room participants.
